title: Fixed-scalar total tensor generators for intrinsic realization
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and $m\in\mathbf N$. Put $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{m+1}$ using [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be a scheme and use its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $F_X$ be the canonical scalar-unit module realization [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], and apply it termwise and on derived categories by its exact equivalence. For fixed-scalar cochain complexes $P,Q$ of $\operatorname{ULift}(A)$-module sheaves, degrees $p,q,k$ with $p+q=k$, a site object $U$, and sections $x\in P^p(U)$ and $y\in Q^q(U)$, define their homogeneous total tensor generator to be the image of $x\otimes y$ under the sheaf tensor comparison and the $(p,q)$-summand inclusion into $\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes Q)^k(U)$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. Define the realization of a local section by the scalar-unit map into $F_X$; no tensor comparison is chosen by this definition.
